parity.existing_journal: version-1 snapshots reopened unchanged by both implementations

limits: Synthetic disposable profiles; no real user quality dataset. Near-miss results demonstrate heuristic limits, not permission to execute.
Training samples are block averages, p95 is across block averages; not per-request tail latency. CPU includes harness and uses OS timer resolution.
Production before/after includes feature extraction and async service access; experimental candidate rows use one shared in-memory ranking harness. Compare only within a row.

Same-process counterbalanced blocks limit drift; GC, JIT and other apps still affect timings. Process memory includes all arms, dependencies and the harness; cache bytes are exact Float64Array buffers, JSON bytes are serialized sizes rather than heap usage.
Seed training includes encrypted persistence and synthetic test feedback, measured for baseline only; test key bypasses DPAPI.

Dense is Float64 for score compatibility, preserves the sparse journal and would need an extra cache. Context-only has no logistic training and changes feedback-sensitive ranking in the controlled tie.
fastText and transformer embeddings were researched only. A separate static-model report measures Model2Vec and BM25. No GPU, cloud model, network latency or native action execution measured.
